**Original Webtoon:**    
R19: [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13311192)     
R15: [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13311155)    
“The only thing that you and I know that for sure was a mistake was for you to have become pregnant. That was a sure mistake. Right?” Kwon Shinwoo, the heir to the Gonyang Group and CEO of Mangang Chemical, and the man who used to be Song Boyeon’s Prince Charming. “I don’t care if people find out that we slept together.” “Would you still not care if they found out that we had a child?” After an unexpected reunion with Boyeon, Shinwoo starts to linger around her again. Boyeon accepts an offer to keep Daseul safe, the child he abandoned, with all of the misunderstandings and hurt she has in her heart. “How far would you go to help us?” “Anything that you can think of.” Boyeon’s only goal is to find a way back to a more peaceful time and stop Kwon Shinwoo from being a part of her life.
